alice_support: Opening an escalation for a tenant hitting perceived throttling during bursts. Customer sees intermittent 429s plus p99 token latency spikes when they send short high-concurrency bursts. Repro steps and logs below.

maria_csr: Customer reports it started after they enabled KV prefetch and reduced batch_window_ms to 25ms to lower latency. They say it looks like requests get queued and then a bunch of cache-warmup work triggers 429s. 

ben_runtime: Can you paste a sample request + headers and any x-redwood-req ids? Also which model/quantization?

alice_support: Here's a sanitized curl they used and an example req id:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
  -d '{"model":"rwd-7b-q4_0","input":"summarize: short text","max_tokens":64, "stream":false}'
```
Logs: `x-redwood-req: 01F8XYZABC`

carla_infra: Top-level observation: when kv_prefetch is enabled we pre-populate KV with prefix cache entries which can create a burst of internal RPCs. Combined with continuous batching it can temporarily exhaust the per-tenant inflight window and trigger our throttler. Seems consistent.

ben_runtime: Agreed. Two things likely interacting: (1) prefetch causes a wave of KV loads on cold keyspace, (2) continuous batching tries to absorb low-latency requests but opens larger batches when many arrive at once, increasing resource contention. The throttler sees token/RPC rate spike and returns 429 for some requests -> perceived throttling.

maria_csr: Customer's tenant config: `kv_prefetch: true`, `kv_prefetch.max_inflight: 64`, `batch.window_ms: 25`, `max_concurrency_per_tenant: 32`. They said they reduced batch.window_ms to push lower latency.

eve_sre: Quick repro attempt on staging using those settings replicated the behavior. I saw a sudden jump in db RPCs and a transient error rate. Metrics: kv.prefetch_rpc_qps spiked 6x, tenant.inflight_conns hit the 32 cap, throttler.rejected 12% over 30s.

carla_infra: Short-term mitigation: advise customer to temporarily disable kv_prefetch OR lower kv_prefetch.max_inflight to 8-12. Also increase batch.window_ms to 50-75ms so batching smooths bursts rather than sending many tiny batches quickly.

ben_runtime: Another option: set `max_concurrency_per_tenant` to 8-12 temporarily to avoid hitting the throttler and re-evaluate after warmup. We should also consider adjusting the throttler policy for dedicated pools with high prefetch.

alice_support: Suggested message to customer drafted: "We believe KV prefetch + very small batch window is causing bursty backend load. Please temporarily set kv_prefetch.max_inflight=12 and batch.window_ms=60ms (we can do this for you) and confirm if errors drop." :thumbsup:

maria_csr: Customer asked for exact command we can run on their Dedicated cluster.

ben_runtime: Use the admin CLI to patch tenant config: 
```
# admin actions (run from ops)
rwdctl tenant update --id acme-inc --set kv_prefetch.max_inflight=12
rwdctl tenant update --id acme-inc --set batch.window_ms=60
```
I recommend also adding a short-term rate uplift: `rwdctl tenant update --id acme-inc --set max_concurrency_per_tenant=12` until keys warm.

deploy-bot: Noted. Will schedule a quick canary config push for that tenant in prod at +2m. Link: https://console.redwood.ai/tenants/acme-inc/config (ops-only)

eve_sre: For longer-term, we should add adaptive prefetch backpressure: cap prefetch RPCs when the throttler is active, or stagger prefetches across worker shards. Filing a follow-up RFC and ticket.

carla_infra: Filed ISSUE-4238: "kv_prefetch: adaptive backoff to prevent throttling during bursts". Assigning to runtime infra.

alice_support: Customer agreed to the temporary changes; I'll apply them now and monitor. Will update when they confirm reduction in 429s. Thanks all.

ben_runtime: If the customer still sees errors after the mitigations, collect a flame graph and the consumer-side batch size distribution; also include kv cache hit/miss over time.

alice_support: Will collect metrics and reopen if needed. Marking this P1 (escalated) until warmup window passes. :white_check_mark:
